animations.name: Medium Kick Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE sharp Guile-style SF6 crouching medium kick across the clip (one kick only, never twice), pure body motion in empty air: NEVER rise or stand up—keep hips and head strictly low at crouch height throughout the entire wind-up, kick, and recovery. he shifts low onto his bent support leg and drives ONE crisp, straight military low sliding poke kick far forward along the ground baseline (kicking leg extended straight right just above the floor, rear arm braced back for balance, front fist in guard); brief apex hold at full reach, then smooth retraction back into the starting kneeling crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, beard, plaid shirt, cargo pants, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Keep entire body inside 512x512 with margin. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
